## Description {#details}

<p>Measures the elapsed time of an operation.</p>


<p><span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="#af5ebb1e454867633db12fef45db9788d">start()</a></span> reads the system clock just before the measured operation and <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="#a83ab4e25e25a4a81ed1d3277ac09390d">stop()</a></span> just after it; when both readings are available, <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="#a3719382123c6741054a89e4f76b55d90">elapsed()</a></span> returns the interval between them.</p>


<p>Each call reads the clock again: <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="#af5ebb1e454867633db12fef45db9788d">start()</a></span> restarts the measurement, discarding both previous readings, and <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="#a83ab4e25e25a4a81ed1d3277ac09390d">stop()</a></span> replaces the previous stop reading, if any. A zero reading means that the clock was not read, either because the stopwatch was not started (or stopped), or because the platform has no clock; in both cases <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="#a3f84d3511f9130c9daefac85e2a772d7">has_elapsed()</a></span> returns <span class="doxyComputerOutput">false</span>, so that the reporters can skip the timing output.</p>


<p>Typical usage in the framework:</p>


<ol class="doxyList" type="1">
<li>Call <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="#af5ebb1e454867633db12fef45db9788d">start()</a></span> just before the test suite or session body executes.</li>
<li>Call <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="#a83ab4e25e25a4a81ed1d3277ac09390d">stop()</a></span> immediately after it completes.</li>
<li>The reporters display <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="#a3719382123c6741054a89e4f76b55d90">elapsed()</a></span>, when <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="#a3f84d3511f9130c9daefac85e2a772d7">has_elapsed()</a></span>.</li>
</ol>

<p>The class is non-copyable and non-movable to prevent accidental sharing of live timing state.</p>


<p>The class is <span class="doxyComputerOutput">final</span>; the non-public members are <span class="doxyComputerOutput">private</span>, and only the unit tests, through a friend, set known readings.</p>


<p>The public members of the v5.0.1 <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/namespaces/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/detail/#a53a6bc7f86b15378c8296b3647e7013f">detail::timestamps</a></span> class (<span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="#a621a32c96a4950306c0a1aef8c577740">timestamp_begin()</a></span>, <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="#a4c1a4d8b22d04205be49f8289ed7abd6">timestamp_end()</a></span>, <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="#a306d33023758a96948a6b24ea7a5dc06">has_begin()</a></span>, <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="#adbabde73dd4f7588ae46f8d051d120e1">has_end()</a></span>, <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="#ac698189ef451dfe398d779eb7cccda7f">has_timestamps()</a></span>, and <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="#afd1213b3e3ffa9997ab0eba78b944ecf">compute_elapsed_time()</a></span>) are kept, deprecated, for the applications that used the deprecated <span class="doxyComputerOutput">timings()</span> of the runner and of the suites, which return a reference to this class.</p>

<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Gets the time elapsed between <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="#af5ebb1e454867633db12fef45db9788d">start()</a></span> and <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="#a83ab4e25e25a4a81ed1d3277ac09390d">stop()</a></span>.</p>


<p>The interval is truncated to whole microseconds. Without both readings (see <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="#a3f84d3511f9130c9daefac85e2a772d7">has_elapsed()</a></span>), the elapsed time is zero.</p>

<dd><p>The elapsed time, in microseconds.</p></dd>
</dl>


<p>Converts the differences of the seconds and of the nanoseconds members to a single nanoseconds duration, so that a negative nanoseconds difference borrows from the seconds without explicit normalisation, and truncates the result to whole microseconds. If <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="#a3f84d3511f9130c9daefac85e2a772d7">has_elapsed()</a></span> is <span class="doxyComputerOutput">false</span>, the result is zero.</p>

<p>Records the start time, from the system clock.</p>


<p>Each call restarts the measurement: the stop reading is cleared, so <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="#a3f84d3511f9130c9daefac85e2a772d7">has_elapsed()</a></span> is <span class="doxyComputerOutput">false</span> until the next <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="#a83ab4e25e25a4a81ed1d3277ac09390d">stop()</a></span>.</p>

The readings are cleared first because <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/namespaces/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/detail/#a60dcef812e43e13d1e30f602a572e27a">read_clock()</a></span> leaves its argument unchanged on the platforms without a clock, where a previous reading would otherwise survive.</p>
